svg.title: Change the comparison set when new information is supplied
svg.desc: A weighted genotype display for Aa×Aa gives AA one-quarter, Aa one-half and aa one-quarter. Under a fully penetrant recessive model, knowing the offspring is unaffected excludes aa; retained probability is three-quarters and carrier probability is(1/2)/(3/4)=2/3, rather than the unconditional1/2. The display retains unequal genotype weights instead of treating the three genotypes as equally likely. Separate boxes show the independent joint probability P(aa and bb)=1/16 and the sum of mutually exclusive parental combinations Aa or aA=1/2. The product rule requires independence, and overlapping events require overlap accounting.

g.text: Change the comparison set when new information is supplied
Conditional probability, multiplication and addition answer different questions.
Aa × Aa, fully penetrant recessive model: aa is affected.
Condition: the offspring is known to be unaffected. Keep AA and Aa; their total weight is ¾.
P(carrier | unaffected) = (½) / (¾) = ⅔. The unconditional carrier probability was ½.
P(Aa or aA) = ¼ + ¼ = ½.
Do not add overlapping events as if separate.
